CBIC.name: Chennai-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor (CBIC) - Package 2
CBIC.memo: The Chennai-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor (CBIC) - Package 2 in District Ranipet faces a critical 99.3% delay probability due to an active court stay projecting a 90-day legal dispute delay impact, compounded by the significant acquisition of 340.5 Ha for 420 Project Affected Families. The District Collector and Legal Cell must urgently coordinate to vacate the active stay order and deploy additional revenue surveyor teams for precise cadastral demarcation and Joint Measurement Survey to expedite land acquisition processes. These concerted actions are imperative to achieve resolution within 14-30 days, preventing a projected 90-day judicial delay and ensuring compliance with the RFCTLARR Act, 2013.

MAHSR.name: Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail (MAHSR) - Palghar Section
MAHSR.memo: The MAHSR-MH-PAL03 section faces a critical delay probability due to an active judicial stay order projecting 180 days of delay, significant land acquisition challenges involving 286.4 Ha, and potential grievances from 890 Project Affected Families. Accordingly, the District Collector, in coordination with the Legal Cell, is directed to immediately expedite the vacation of the active court stay, deploy additional land administration teams for swift parcel demarcation and Joint Measurement Survey of the 286.4 Ha, and convene urgent Special Gram Sabhas for prompt redressal of grievances concerning the 890 Project Affected Families. These decisive actions are imperative within the next 14-30 days to avert the projected 180 days of judicial delay and ensure adherence to the timelines stipulated under the RFCTLARR Act, 2013.

BSRP.name: Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project (BSRP) - Corridor 4 (Heelalige to Rajanukunte)
BSRP.memo: Project Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project (BSRP) - Corridor 4 (Heelalige to Rajanukunte) (BSRP-KA-CORR04) in Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka maintains a LOW delay risk profile with steady milestone progression across 128.0 hectares. The District Collector and Special Land Acquisition Officer (SLAO) must immediately continue scheduled compensation disbursements to maintain high clearance rates in direct liaison with the Rail Transit Project Implementation Unit. Initiating this intervention within 14 days is projected to prevent payment backlogs and maintain landholder satisfaction and protect the statutory acquisition timeline under RFCTLARR 2013.

The District Collector and Special Land Acquisition Officer (SLAO) must immediately coordinate with legal cell to expedite resolution of active stay order / litigation in direct liaison with the Industrial / Expressway Project Implementation Unit.
